_comment: The board loop. Ticks are not used here; times are seconds.

bomb._comment: Thrown: lands anywhere within range_spaces (mean tile spacings) of the thrower; everyone within blast_spaces of the landing, the thrower included, takes damage_close at the centre falling to damage_far at the edge and is knocked back knockback spaces. At 0 HP the victim respawns and hands death_coin_share of their coins to the thrower.

portal._comment: A portal to the picked player: you go through, then push them back through it; the two swap spaces.

laser._comment: Aimed on your turn: a straight beam length_spaces spaces long (spaces = the board's mean tile spacing) and width metres wide hits every other player in it; damage_close within close_spaces, falling to damage_far at the end. At 0 HP the victim respawns at the annex that is not the live machine and hands death_coin_share of their coins to the shooter.

claw._comment: The retractable claw, aimed like the laser: it extends range_spaces (mean tile spacings) along its line, width metres wide, and grabs one item at random from the first player in its path, coins_when_empty coins when their bar is empty. A shield eats the grab; nothing in the path and it comes back empty, spent.
